transcript.text: Hello, welcome to Glow Beauty Salon, this is Elsie. How can I help?
Hi Elsie, yeah I'd like to book in for a gel manicure please, ideally Thursday afternoon if you've got anything available?
Lovely, let me check that for you! So for Thursday afternoon, I've got a slot at 2:30pm — does that work for you?
Yeah, 2:30 Thursday is perfect, thanks! So that's Sarah Okafor, and you can reach me on 07853 992555.
Great, let me just confirm — that's Sarah Okafor, S-A-R-A-H O-K-A-F-O-R? And the number is the one you're calling from, 07853 992555 — is that right?
Yes, that's all correct! Thanks so much, I'll see you Thursday at 2:30 then. Cheers, Elsie!

Perfect, let me get that booked in for you now! You're all booked in, Sarah! Gel manicure, Thursday at 2:30pm — we'll see you then. Take care! I've also sent a confirmation text over to you. Bye for now! 😊

input.message: Hi Sarah, this is Glow Beauty Salon confirming your gel manicure on Thursday 2nd July at 2:30pm. We're on King Street, Manchester. See you then! 💅

verdict.notes: Elsie handled the booking cleanly — captured name, number, service, and preferred time, confirmed the slot, used all appropriate tools, and sent an SMS confirmation. No address or additional detail (e.g. nail length preference, allergies) was gathered, but this is a minor gap unlikely to be required for a standard gel manicure booking.
